hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen's eligibility crisis
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen faces a critical court ruling on July 7 that could bar her from the 2027 French presidential election due to a 2025 conviction for misusing EU parliamentary assistants' funds. The verdict will determine if she remains the RN's candidate or if Jordan Bardella takes her place.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention because it directly impacts the leadership and future of France's far-right movement, with potential ripple effects across Europe.

hotspots.title: Trump-Meloni feud escalates ahead of NATO summit
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump intensified his feud with Italian PM Giorgia Meloni by posting a meme on Truth Social demanding a 'restraining order' against her, just days before their meeting at the NATO summit in Ankara. Italian officials dismissed the attack as a provocation but reaffirmed strong U.S.-Italy relations.
hotspots.affect: The personal and public nature of Trump's attacks on a key NATO ally commands high affective investment due to its implications for transatlantic relations and alliance unity.

hotspots.title: AfD party congress protests
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right AfD held its party congress in Erfurt amid massive protests, with tens of thousands demonstrating against the party. The event saw violent clashes, attacks on journalists, and a reaffirmation of the AfD's ambition to govern, despite internal power struggles.
hotspots.affect: The protests and the AfD's radicalization command high affective investment due to fears of far-right governance in Germany and the erosion of democratic norms.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage funding scandal
hotspots.blurb: Nigel Farage faces multiple investigations over undeclared financial support from convicted fraudster George Cottrell, including staffing, security, and housing. The scandal threatens his leadership of Reform UK and could trigger a by-election.
hotspots.affect: The scandal commands high affective investment due to its implications for Farage's credibility, Reform UK's future, and broader concerns about political funding transparency.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei's re-election strategy unfolds
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei is reshaping his government and political strategy to secure re-election in 2027, including cabinet changes, alliances with governors, and efforts to eliminate PASO primaries. His approval rating has risen, but corruption concerns persist.
hotspots.affect: Milei's re-election strategy commands high affective investment due to its impact on Argentina's political and economic future, with intense framing around his libertarian policies and governance style.
